title: 第17章 玄天宗集市第18章 有办法对付他们了
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
估摸着御兽峰的人已经离开，秦宇又溜达回枫叶广场。
上面不出意外的多了一些灵兽的排泄物，看这次的量比之前的都要多。
应该是李正通昨天的行为惹怒了他们，被他们报复了。
秦宇在心里暗骂一句，快步走到李正通身旁。
“他们有说什么吗？”
“他们就问了一下这树上的叶子怎么不见了，其他倒是没说什么。”
秦宇点点头，“行吧，开干吧！”
“等晚上完活后，咱们去钓几条鱼烤着吃！”
李正通听后也很是开心，这几天他也靠着辟谷丹度日，对美食也是十分怀念。
两个人干活要比一个人快很多。
二人一通忙碌，很快就将垃圾处理完毕。
秦宇拍了拍衣服，对着李正通说道：“你再收拾一下这些碎树叶，我去随便逛逛。”
“好！”
秦宇顺着御兽峰众弟子经过的路线溜达。
那些灵兽不可能只在广场上拉，一路上也肯定没放过。
不过秦宇发现，那些灵兽不会在一些大道上随地大小便，因为这些大道上没有杂役弟子清理。
也就是说，这些灵兽是能控制自己的。
它们到广场上拉，就是故意把广场当成厕所。
而他们杂役弟子就是它们的铲屎官。
这才是御兽峰外门弟子最可恨的地方。

秦宇估计，这些灵兽不可能只针对他们，其他有杂役弟子负责的地方应该也都被当成厕所了。
不出所料，秦宇很快便碰到了第一个受害的杂役弟子。
这个人名叫小智，也是今年刚进宗门的杂役弟子。
秦宇不认识他，他倒是认出了秦宇。
简单聊了两句，小智便开始跟秦宇哭诉御兽峰的灵兽问题。
小智也出面反抗了一下，结果被御兽峰的弟子怒骂了一顿。
不过小智并没有挨打，看来也只有极少数的倒霉蛋会挨打。
秦宇猜测，有可能御兽峰众弟子刚被小智烦过，结果到了枫叶广场，又遇到了李正通。
心情烦躁之下，才给了李正通一巴掌。
默默记下这边的情况，秦宇继续向前走。
不到半个小时的时间，秦宇就遇到了五六个遇到同样问题的杂役弟子。
人多力量大！
和御兽峰有仇的人越多越好。
秦宇想把大家团结起来，一起对抗御兽峰弟子。
但秦宇一时半会又想不出该怎么做，就算他们人再多，在人家御兽峰外门弟子面前也就是多打几拳的事。
content_en:
Guessing that the people from Yushou Peak had left, Qin Yu strolled back to Maple Leaf Square.
Not surprisingly, there was some excrement from spirit beasts on it. It seemed that the amount this time was larger than before.
It should be that Li Zhengtong's behavior yesterday angered them and they took revenge.
Qin Yu cursed secretly in his heart and walked quickly to Li Zhengtong's side.
"Did they say anything?"
"They just asked why the leaves on the tree were missing, but they didn't say anything else."
Qin Yu nodded, "Okay, let's get started!"
"After we finish our work in the evening, let's go catch some fish and grill them!"
Li Zhengtong was also very happy after hearing this. He also relied on Bigu Pill these days and missed the food very much.
Two people can work much faster than one person.
The two of them got busy and quickly finished disposing of the garbage.
Qin Yu patted his clothes and said to Li Zhengtong, "Please pick up these broken leaves and I'll go for a walk."
"Okay!"
Qin Yu walked along the route passed by the disciples of Yushou Peak.
Those spirit beasts couldn't just be pulled in the square, they definitely weren't let go along the way.
However, Qin Yu discovered that those spiritual beasts would not defecate on some avenues because there were no handyman disciples to clean them up.
In other words, these spiritual beasts can control themselves.
They go to the square to poop, deliberately using the square as a toilet.
And their handyman disciples are their shit shoveling officers.
This is the most hateful thing about the outer disciples of Yushou Peak.
Qin Yu estimated that these spiritual beasts could not only target them. Other places where handyman disciples were responsible should also be used as toilets.
As expected, Qin Yu soon met the first victimized handyman disciple.
This person's name is Xiaozhi, and he is also a handyman disciple who just entered the sect this year.
Qin Yu didn't recognize him, but he recognized Qin Yu.
After a brief chat, Xiaozhi began to cry to Qin Yu about the problem of the spirit beasts at the Royal Beast Peak.
Xiaozhi also resisted, but was scolded by the disciples of the Beast Control Peak.
However, Xiaozhi did not get beaten, and it seemed that only a few unlucky ones would.
Qin Yu guessed that it was possible that the disciples of the Royal Beast Peak had just been annoyed by Xiao Zhi, and then they met Li Zhengtong again when they arrived at Maple Leaf Square.
In a irritable mood, he slapped Li Zhengtong.
Silently taking note of the situation here, Qin Yu continued to move forward.
In less than half an hour, Qin Yu met five or six handyman disciples who encountered the same problem.
There is strength in numbers!
The more people who have a grudge against Yushou Peak, the better.
Qin Yu wants to unite everyone to fight against the disciples of Yushou Peak.
But Qin Yu couldn't think of what to do for a while. No matter how many of them there were, it was just a matter of punching a few more times in front of the outer disciples of the Beast Control Peak.
